_readme: Site-wide settings. Edit, then run: python3 build.py
name: Archive 88
title: Archive 88 - Curated Pieces, Limited Edition
description: Archive 88 is a curated clothing archive. Every piece is hand-picked, repaired, numbered and released once. Limited edition, est. 1988.

social._note: PLACEHOLDER handles. Replace with the real profiles.

business._note: PLACEHOLDERS. UK distance-selling rules require your trading name, a geographic address and a way to contact you. Fill these in; empty values show as 'To be confirmed'.

drops._note: SAMPLE dates. One entry per drop, oldest first. The latest drop whose date has passed is shown on the homepage; the next future one drives the countdown. Times are UK (ISO 8601).

categories.description: Chore coats, waxed jackets and field layers, built for weather.

categories.title: Knitwear

categories.title: Denim

categories.title: Workwear

shipping._note: PLACEHOLDER wording. Replace with your real rates and times.
shipping.text: Dispatched within 2 working days, tracked. UK delivery 1 to 3 working days. International rates are shown at checkout.

returns_faq.a: 30 days from the day your order is delivered.

returns_faq.q: What condition does it need to be in?
returns_faq.a: The way it reached you: unworn, unwashed, with the Archive 88 woven label and the numbered hang tag still attached.

returns_faq.q: Can I exchange for another size?
returns_faq.a: Every piece is one of one, so there's no other size to swap to. Return it for a refund and choose something else from the archive.

returns_faq.q: How long does a refund take?
returns_faq.a: We check every return by hand. Once it's approved, the refund goes back to your original payment method. Your bank may take a few more days to show it.
Pieces marked "Final sale" are excluded from our 30-day returns. This doesn't affect your legal right to cancel an online order within 14 days of delivery.
